2607.28272.title: MemHarness: Memory Is Reconstructed, Not Replayed
2607.28272.paper_summary: Retrieving past experiences has become a common strategy to enhance large language model agents. However, most existing memory-augmented agents treat retrieved experiences as static records to be replayed verbatim, injecting them into the context regardless of whether they align with the agent's current situation. This ``replay'' paradigm ignores the gap between the abstract, general nature of stored experience and the concrete, ever-changing states encountered at decision time, frequently causing negative transfer. In contrast, humans rarely recall past experiences verbatim; instead, they reorganize and adapt retrieved memories to fit the present context. Inspired by this, we propose MemHarness, a framework that equips LLM agents to actively harness and reconstruct past experiences based on the present context. At each decision step, a unified policy model critiques and reconstructs the retrieved experience conditioned on the current state, producing context-grounded guidance before acting. This reconstructive ability emerges naturally through end-to-end training with GRPO. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that MemHarness substantially outperforms pure RL and static memory-augmented baselines, demonstrating strong robustness in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. Furthermore, our analyses reveal that this reconstruction objective not only prevents negative transfer but also serves as latent guidance during training, fundamentally improving the agent's intrinsic reasoning capabilities.
2607.28272.paper_summary_zh: 檢索過去的經驗已成為增強大型語言模型代理的常見策略。<lb/>然而，大多數現有的記憶增強代理將檢索到的經驗視為靜態記錄，逐字重播，無論這些經驗是否與代理的當前情況相符，都將其注入上下文中。<lb/>這種「重播」範式忽略了存儲經驗的抽象、一般性質與在決策時遇到的具體、不斷變化的狀態之間的差距，經常導致負轉移。<lb/>相比之下，人類很少逐字回憶過去的經驗；相反，他們會重新組織和調整檢索到的記憶以適應當前的上下文。<lb/>受到這一點的啟發，我們提出了MemHarness，一個框架，旨在使LLM代理能夠根據當前上下文主動利用和重建過去的經驗。<lb/>在每個決策步驟中，統一策略模型會根據當前狀態對檢索到的經驗進行批評和重建，在行動之前生成基於上下文的指導。<lb/>這種重建能力通過與GRPO的端到端訓練自然產生。<lb/>在ALFWorld和WebShop上的實驗顯示，MemHarness顯著優於純強化學習和靜態記憶增強基準，並在分佈外（OOD）場景中展現出強大的穩健性。<lb/>此外，我們的分析顯示，這一重建目標不僅防止了負轉移，還在訓練過程中作為潛在指導，根本上改善了代理的內在推理能力。
